tools.name: clipforge_run
tools.description: Trim, watermark, extract audio, burn subtitles, and convert videos to 9:16 vertical using the ClipForge Apify Actor. Supports direct file URLs and YouTube/yt-dlp links.

action.description: Select the media processing operation to execute (e.g., trim, extract-clip, watermark, convert-vertical-subtitles).

inputUrl.description: Direct HTTP/HTTPS URL to the source media file or YouTube/yt-dlp supported link.

startTime.description: Start offset in seconds (required for 'trim' and 'extract-clip').

duration.description: Clip duration in seconds (required for 'trim' and 'extract-clip').

format.description: Output format for the 'extract-clip' action (mp3 or mp4).

watermarkUrl.description: Direct HTTP/HTTPS URL to a PNG/JPEG image for the 'watermark' action.

subtitles.description: Raw SRT subtitle text or a public URL to an .srt file for the 'convert-vertical-subtitles' action.
